text:
Liam: CI run for #infra-config (main) is red on the 'deploy-artifacts' job, looks like a secret fetch error. seeing: `secret-provider: fetch failed: 403 Forbidden for path /repos/redwood/infra/ci`
Priya: ugh, did we rotate the repo token yesterday?
Alex: We rotated the deploy SA creds last night for the new KMS keys, but that shouldn't affect repo access. error log?
Liam: pastebin: https://paste.redwood/insecure/abc123 (excerpt)
```
2026-06-12T09:12:03Z secret-provider ERROR fetch: status=403 body={"message":"AccessDenied","detail":"principal not authorized"}
2026-06-12T09:12:03Z gha-run ERROR job failed: deploy-artifacts
```
Priya: hmm, the secret-provider uses the github-app installation token + KMS unwrap. if KMS unwrap failed earlier we'd see decrypt errors though. this is 403 from GH API.
Sam: @Liam can you confirm the GitHub App installation still exists and the app key wasn't rotated? we had an incident where the app was accidentally uninstalled on one org.
deploy-bot: [action] workflow run 879123 failed (deploy-artifacts) :x: 
enginfra-oncall: assigning to @Alex to verify GH app permissions and check token validity. if it's a token expiry we'll need a rerun after patch.
Alex: looking now — GH app shows 'active' but the installation id for the infra repo returned 404 when I hit /app/installations/:id/access_tokens. suspect the app key used by our secret provider is the old one.
Priya: did we rotate the private key for the GH app when we rotated the SA? timeline?
Alex: yes, rotated at 2026-06-11 23:40 UTC. I see a mismatch: the secret-provider in namespace infra/cicreds still holds the old base64 key (k8s secret). kube secret didn't get updated by the secret-sync job due to RBAC change yesterday.
Liam: ah ok. can we do a quick hotfix to replace the k8s secret with the new key and rerun CI?
Sam: +1. steps: 1) update infra/cicreds GH_APP_PRIVATE_KEY (base64), 2) restart secret-provider deployment, 3) rerun failing job with `gh run rerun 879123` or from UI.
Alex: applying patch now. patch command: `kubectl -n infra create secret generic cicreds --from-literal=GH_APP_PRIVATE_KEY=REDACTED --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -` then `kubectl rollout restart deploy/secret-provider`
Priya: also adding a short note to the runbook: ensure secret-sync SA keeps write access to infra namespace after RBAC edits.
enginfra-oncall: starting a quick bisect if rerun fails: run CI against commit range `main~10..main~1` using the ephemeral workflow. but try rerun first.
Alex: restarted secret-provider, logs show successful token creation and KMS unwrap ok: `created installation token for installation 112233`
deploy-bot: [action] workflow run 879123 rerun requested by Alex :arrow_forward:
Liam: reran, looks like job is replaying.
(10m later)
Liam: good news — job finished green. :tada: root cause = stale GH app private key in k8s secret after RBAC prevented secret-sync update.
Priya: filing a follow-up to add an alert when secret-sync writes fail and to add a CI precheck for GH app access.
Alex: created GH issue #1428 and an internal runbook PR. closing the thread unless anyone wants follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
